snippet.title: Walk The Frog | Game Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Walk The Frog is a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style. Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles.
